instruction: Lift the red plastic bin off the workbench by its rim, at least 10 cm, and hold it for 1 s.
success_conditions: The red bin is at least 10 cm above the bench top and stays there for 1 s.
The bin was grasped by one wall of its rim.

conditions.says: the red bin is at least 10 cm above the bench top for 1 s

failure: The red bin is knocked off the bench (more than 5 cm below the bench top).

initial_state.says: the red bin starts on the bench top
the gripper starts open and empty
